description: Security configuration for Purchase Order Application

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.PO_Read
scopes.description: Read Purchase Orders and related data

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Admin_Manage
scopes.description: Full administrative access to all features

attributes.name: plant
attributes.description: Manufacturing Plant the user belongs to

role-templates.name: PO_Viewer
role-templates.description: Can view Purchase Orders and Dashboard only

role-templates.name: PO_Creator
role-templates.description: Can create, edit and submit Purchase Orders

role-templates.name: PO_Approver
role-templates.description: Can review, approve and reject Purchase Orders

role-templates.name: PO_Admin
role-templates.description: Full access to all Purchase Order features

role-collections.name: PurchaseOrder_Viewer
role-collections.description: Assigned to users who only need to view POs

role-collections.name: PurchaseOrder_Creator
role-collections.description: Assigned to users who create and submit POs

role-collections.name: PurchaseOrder_Approver
role-collections.description: Assigned to users who review and approve POs

role-collections.name: PurchaseOrder_Admin
role-collections.description: Assigned to administrators with full access
